title: Tahiri (Spicy Basmati Rice with Potatoes)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A spicy holiday rice the author's family had about once a month, like a potato curry and rice cooked together. Good for a special brunch; serve with meat or vegetables (not daal), or plain with raita or chutney.

steps.action: Rinse in a large bowl until the water runs almost clear (removes starch that makes grains stick); drain well:
Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and stir about 1 min, until the cumin darkens slightly:
Add and stir about 1 min, until just darker and fragrant; move on fast so the garlic doesn't burn:
items: 5 medium garlic cloves, very finely chopped (or 1 Tbsp garlic paste)
2 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 5 cm), finely chopped (or 2 Tbsp ginger paste)

steps.action: Add; stir and reduce to medium-high (7/10):
items: 3 medium tomatoes, in ⅓ in (1 cm) dice (or 14 oz / 400 g can)
2 medium potatoes (12 oz / 340 g total), peeled, in 1 in (2.5 cm) cubes

steps.action: Cook on medium (5/10) 10 min, stirring often, until the oil begins to separate.
Add, mix, and bring to a boil on high:
Cover tightly; cook on low (2/10) exactly 28 min. Turn off heat and rest covered 5 min. Never lift the lid while cooking.
